title: Dashboard layout
question: Three structures for the home dashboard, all in the HC Tracking red/gray world with Somar Sans. Lock one, steer, or re-roll.

options.label: Triage Bento
options.lineage: Asymmetric bento board where a tile's size tracks its urgency
options.thesis: The biggest tile is always what's slipping today; everything else steps down in size by urgency.
options.viewport: Greeting + date + your 'My work' chips on top; a 7-column Needs Attention queue beside a stacked Funding Position tile per currency (USD/EUR/SYP); five count tiles underneath.
options.risk: Bento can drift into decoration if tile sizes stop meaning urgency.

options.label: Program Health Matrix
options.lineage: Portfolio heat grid: programs as rows, health dimensions as columns
options.thesis: One grid answers 'which program is in trouble, and on what': every cell is a status and a link.
options.viewport: Attention ribbon of five critical counters + My work strip on top; below, a matrix of all 14 programs × Plan / Milestones / Tasks / Risks / Reports / Funding, with Funding Position in a right rail.
options.risk: A 6-column matrix gets dense on phones; it stacks into one program card per row there.

options.label: 90-Day Horizon
options.lineage: One shared time axis, 30 days back to 60 days ahead, with a Today line
options.thesis: Every deadline in the system on one timeline: what's overdue piles up left of Today, what's coming sits to the right.
options.viewport: KPI tiles + My work on top; a full-width horizon with lanes for Milestones, Tasks, Transfers, Reports and Proposal deadlines; below, Funding Position and pipeline side by side.
options.risk: Busy weeks cluster markers; the lanes need grouping and counts to stay readable.

raised.raise: All delivery and money signals share one time axis instead of separate pages.

options.label: Signal Bench
options.viewport: One screen of overlaid signal traces.
options.case: Loses on audience and clarity; its shared-axis discipline went into 90-Day Horizon.
options.kept: One time axis for every signal.

options.label: Cutaway Town
options.thesis: Every program as a labeled building.
options.risk: Playful illustration undermines a funding manager's trust.
options.case: Loses both axes for daily operational use.
